definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of isogobliosides that begins with the synthesis of a tetrasaccharide core GalNAc-beta-1,3Gal-alpha-1,3Gal-beta-1,4Glc-ceramide. This core can be further elongated with the sequential addition of various carbohydrate units.
label: isogloboside biosynthetic process
